story.text: 오늘 여기로 오자고 한 거, 사실 다 이유가 있어요. 잠깐 제 얘기 좀 들어줄래요?
story.reading: o-neul yeo-gi-ro o-ja-go han geo, sa-sil da i-yu-ga i-sseo-yo. jam-kkan je yae-gi jom deul-eo-jul-lae-yo?
story.en: There's actually a reason I asked you to come here today. Can you listen to me for a moment?

story.text: 저 사실... 어제부터 계속 '고백' 멘트를 준비했거든요. 근데 이게 생각보다 어렵네요.
story.reading: jeo sa-sil... eo-je-bu-teo gye-sok go-baek men-teu-reul jun-bi-haet-geo-deun-yo. geun-de i-ge saeng-gak-bo-da eo-ryeop-ne-yo.
story.en: Actually... I've been preparing a 'confession' line since yesterday. But it's way harder than I thought.

story.text: 핸드폰에 '편지'처럼 써놨는데, 막상 꺼내려니까 손이 떨리네요.
story.reading: haen-deu-pon-e pyeon-ji-cheo-reom sseo-nwat-neun-de, mak-sang kkeo-nae-ryeo-ni-kka son-i tteol-li-ne-yo.
story.en: I wrote it out like a 'letter' on my phone, but now that I actually want to pull it out, my hands are shaking.

story.text: 덕수궁 '돌담길' 걸으면 헤어진다는 얘기 있잖아요. 그래서 오늘, 저는 반대로 걸어보려고요.
story.reading: deok-su-gung dol-dam-gil geol-eu-myeon hae-eo-jin-da-neun yae-gi it-jan-a-yo. geu-rae-seo o-neul, jeo-neun ban-dae-ro geol-eo-bo-ryeo-go-yo.
story.en: They say couples break up walking this 'stone wall path' at Deoksugung. So today, I'm trying to walk it the opposite way.

story.text: '연습'까지 했는데 왜 하나도 기억이 안 나죠? 능글맞던 규현 기장 다 어디 갔나 몰라요.
story.reading: yeon-seup-kka-ji haet-neun-de wae ha-na-do gi-eok-i an na-jyo? neung-geul-maj-deon gyu-hyeon gi-jang da eo-di gan-na mol-la-yo.
story.en: I even did 'practice', so why can't I remember any of it? Where did smooth Captain Kyuhyun go, I have no idea.

story.text: 그냥 지금 이 '떨림' 그대로 말할게요. 저... 승객님이 진짜 좋아요.
story.reading: geu-nyang ji-geum i tteol-lim geu-dae-ro mal-hal-ge-yo. jeo... seung-gaek-nim-i jin-jja jo-a-yo.
story.en: I'll just say it with this 'trembling', just as it is. I... I really like you.

story.text: ...아, 이렇게 말해버렸네요. 크흠, 자, 오늘 배운 단어들 문제로 확인해볼까요?
story.reading: ...a, i-reo-ke mal-hae-beo-ryeot-ne-yo. keu-heum, ja, o-neul bae-un dan-eo-deul mun-je-ro hwa-gin-hae-bol-kka-yo?
story.en: ...ah, I just said it, just like that. Ahem, well, shall we check today's words with some questions?

words.example_en: I wrote all my feelings in the letter.
We walked the Deoksugung stone wall path together.
I practiced my confession a lot.
I couldn't hide the trembling of my hands.
